title: Batch bill entry
description: Key a stack of vendor bills on one grid, check them against control totals, and save or post them together.
createVendorFailed: The vendor could not be created.
keyboardHint: Enter or Tab moves through a bill, and Tab past the last field starts the next one. F8 copies the field above. Paste rows from a spreadsheet, with a header row to match columns by name. Ctrl+S (⌘S) saves every bill as a draft.
keyboardHintPost: Enter or Tab moves through a bill, and Tab past the last field starts the next one. F8 copies the field above. Paste rows from a spreadsheet, with a header row to match columns by name. Ctrl+S (⌘S) saves every bill as a draft; Ctrl+Enter (⌘Enter) posts them.

columns.dueDateHelp: Leave blank to use the vendor's payment terms. The status column shows the date the terms give.

control.heading: Control totals
control.entered: Entered: {count, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}} · {total}
control.countInvalid: Enter the number of bills as a whole number
control.totalInvalid: Enter the batch total as an amount

issues.amountInvalid: The amount is not a number
issues.amountNotPositive: Enter a positive amount; record a negative bill as a vendor credit

duplicates.inBatch: Same vendor and vendor ref # as row {rows}
duplicates.title: Possible duplicate bills
duplicates.message: {count, plural, one {# bill has} other {# bills have}} the same vendor and vendor ref # as another bill in this batch or already on file. Save anyway?

refusals.totalChanged: The saved bill total differs from the batch total. Open the saved bill to review its tax and amount before posting.
refusals.taxUnresolved: Tax could not be resolved for a bill date. Check the effective tax rates in Setup and retry saving.
refusals.nothingToSave: There are no unsaved bills in this batch.
refusals.rowsNeedAttention: {count, plural, one {# bill needs} other {# bills need}} attention before anything is saved. {first}
refusals.controlInvalid: The control totals cannot be read. Enter the number of bills as a whole number and the batch total as an amount, or clear them.
refusals.controlCount: The batch has {entered, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}} but the control count is {control, number}. Find the missing or extra bill, or correct the control count.
refusals.controlTotal: The bills total {entered}, which is {difference} {direction, select, over {more} other {less}} than the batch total. Correct the amounts or the batch total.
refusals.saveFailed: The bill could not be saved.
refusals.unavailable: The server could not be reached. The batch is kept; save again to retry, and bills already saved are not created twice.
refusals.conflict: This row's bill may already have been saved with different details. Open the existing bill to check it, or duplicate the row to save it as a new bill.
refusals.refusedSummary: {count, plural, one {# bill was not saved or posted} other {# bills were not saved or posted}}. The reason is shown on each row; correct it and save again.
refusals.defaultsFailed: Vendor defaults could not be loaded. Choose the account on each bill.

summary.saved: {count, plural, one {# bill saved as a draft} other {# bills saved as drafts}}
summary.posted: {posted, plural, one {# bill posted} other {# bills posted}}, {pending, number} awaiting approval

restore.title: Unsaved batch restored
restore.body: {count, plural, one {# unsaved bill} other {# unsaved bills}} from your last session {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} restored.
restore.discardConfirm: Discard the unsaved bills in this batch? This cannot be undone.
restore.storageFailed: This browser could not keep a copy of the batch. Save soon so no bills are lost.

leave.message: This batch has bills that are not saved. They stay in this browser and come back when you reopen batch entry.
